packageRules.description: No update releases by default: mergeweasel's release step releases fix, feat and breaking commits only.
The image's base: an update changes what ships, so it releases.
Test dependencies, and the forges and the runner the tests run against.
The linter and formatter: CI checks the code with them, neither the image nor the tests use them.
The Gitea the end-to-end test passes against is the one mergeweasel supports: a new major releases, and the notes name it.
Test compatibility with a new Gitea or Forgejo release as early as possible.
Workflows: the actions and the pinned mergeweasel image.
This repository runs mergeweasel's latest image: nothing to pin or bump.
The merge queue lands non-major updates; a major update waits for a human.
